cohort: The participants were extremely preterm or extremely low birth weight survivors born in the State of Victoria, Australia between 1991-1992, and matched term-born controls.
finding: While EP/ELBW survivors generally showed similar transition into adulthood across most comparisons, they were more likely to rely on government income, less likely to have moved out of the parental home, and engaged less in risk-taking behaviors compared to term-born controls.
